snippet.title: Rabbids Legends of the multiverse
snippet.description:
Rabbids: Legends of the Multiverse is OUT NOW on Apple Arcade! https://apple.co/3WYRaa2
Explore the Multiverse and assemble the wackiest team of Knight Rabbids, Pirates Rabbids, Cowboy Rabbids... (and many more!)
Build the most improbable deck of Battle cards, set up your combos and unleash the most devastating superpowers...or the most unexpected!
#RabbidsMultiverse #AppleArcade
